source.text: הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֶל־בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּֽן־נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה בְּכָתְבוֹ֩ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֨ים הָאֵ֤לֶּה עַל־סֵ֨פֶר֙ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִעִ֔ית לִיהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: The word which spoke Jeremiah the prophet to Baruch son of Neriah, in his writing these words on a scroll from [the] mouth of Jeremiah, in the year the fourth of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, saying:

en.L: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a scroll from the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying:
en.B: This is the word that the prophet Jeremiah spoke to Baruch son of Neriah in the fourth year of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, when Baruch wrote these words in a scroll at Jeremiah's dictation:
en.R: This is what the prophet Jeremiah said to Baruch son of Neriah. It was in Jehoiakim's fourth year as king of Judah. Jehoiakim was Josiah's son. At that time Baruch was writing down in a scroll the messages Jeremiah spoke to him.

es.L: La palabra que habló Jeremías el profeta a Baruc hijo de Nerías, cuando escribía estas palabras en un rollo de la boca de Jeremías, en el año cuarto de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, diciendo:
es.B: Esta es la palabra que el profeta Jeremías le dijo a Baruc hijo de Nerías en el cuarto año del reinado de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, cuando Baruc escribía estas palabras en un rollo al dictado de Jeremías:
es.R: Esto es lo que el profeta Jeremías le dijo a Baruc hijo de Nerías. Fue en el cuarto año del reinado de Joacim en Judá. Joacim era hijo de Josías. En ese tiempo Baruc estaba escribiendo en un rollo los mensajes que Jeremías le decía.

fr.L: La parole que Jérémie le prophète dit à Baruch fils de Nériya, quand il écrivit ces paroles dans un rouleau, de la bouche de Jérémie, en la quatrième année de Joïaqim fils de Josias, roi de Juda, disant :
fr.B: Voici la parole que le prophète Jérémie adressa à Baruch fils de Nériya, la quatrième année du règne de Joïaqim fils de Josias, roi de Juda, quand Baruch écrivit ces paroles dans un rouleau sous la dictée de Jérémie :
fr.R: Voici ce que le prophète Jérémie a dit à Baruch fils de Nériya. C’était la quatrième année où Joïaqim était roi de Juda. Joïaqim était le fils de Josias. À ce moment-là, Baruch écrivait dans un rouleau les messages que Jérémie lui dictait.

sw.L: Neno ambalo Yeremia nabii alimwambia Baruku mwana wa Neria, alipoyaandika maneno haya katika gombo kutoka kinywani mwa Yeremia, katika mwaka wa nne wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda, kusema:
sw.B: Hili ndilo neno ambalo nabii Yeremia alimwambia Baruku mwana wa Neria katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda, Baruku alipoyaandika maneno haya katika gombo Yeremia akimsomea:
sw.R: Haya ndiyo nabii Yeremia aliyomwambia Baruku mwana wa Neria. Ilikuwa katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu juu ya Yuda. Yehoyakimu alikuwa mwana wa Yosia. Wakati huo Baruku alikuwa akiandika katika gombo jumbe ambazo Yeremia alimwambia.

vi.L: Lời mà nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi đã nói với Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia, khi ông chép những lời này vào cuộn sách từ miệng Giê-rê-mi, vào năm thứ tư đời Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa, rằng:
vi.B: Đây là lời nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi đã nói với Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia vào năm thứ tư đời trị vì của Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa, khi Ba-rúc chép những lời này vào cuộn sách theo lời Giê-rê-mi đọc:
vi.R: Đây là điều nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi đã nói với Ba-rúc con trai Nê-ri-gia. Lúc ấy là năm thứ tư đời Giê-hô-gia-kim làm vua Giu-đa. Giê-hô-gia-kim là con trai Giô-si-a. Bấy giờ Ba-rúc đang chép vào cuộn sách những sứ điệp Giê-rê-mi nói cho ông.

ko.L: 유다 왕 요시야의 아들 여호야김의 제4년에, 네리야의 아들 바룩이 예레미야의 입에서 이 말씀들을 두루마리 책에 받아 기록할 때에, 예언자 예레미야가 그에게 한 말이다.
ko.B: 이것은 유다 왕 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 다스린 지 4년째 되는 해에, 네리야의 아들 바룩이 예레미야가 불러 주는 대로 이 말씀들을 두루마리에 받아 적을 때, 예언자 예레미야가 바룩에게 한 말이다.
ko.R: 이것은 예언자 예레미야가 네리야의 아들 바룩에게 한 말이다. 그때는 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다의 왕이 된 지 4년째 되는 해였다. 그때 바룩은 예레미야가 불러 주는 말씀을 두루마리에 받아 적고 있었다.

pt.L: A palavra que Jeremias, o profeta, falou a Baruque, filho de Nerias, quando ele escreveu estas palavras num rolo, da boca de Jeremias, no quarto ano de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, dizendo:
pt.B: Esta é a palavra que o profeta Jeremias falou a Baruque, filho de Nerias, no quarto ano do reinado de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, quando Baruque escreveu estas palavras num rolo, enquanto Jeremias ditava:
pt.R: Isto é o que o profeta Jeremias disse a Baruque, filho de Nerias. Foi no quarto ano em que Jeoaquim era rei de Judá. Jeoaquim era filho de Josias. Naquele tempo, Baruque estava escrevendo num rolo as mensagens que Jeremias lhe dizia.

am.L: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት፣ የኔርያ ልጅ ባሮክ እነዚህን ቃላት ከኤርምያስ አፍ በጥቅልል መጽሐፍ በጻፈ ጊዜ፣ ለባሮክ እንዲህ ብሎ የተናገረው ቃል፦
am.B: የኢዮስያስ ልጅ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮአቄም በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት፣ የኔርያ ልጅ ባሮክ ኤርምያስ እየነገረው እነዚህን ቃላት በጥቅልል መጽሐፍ በጻፈ ጊዜ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ለባሮክ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው፦
am.R: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክ የተናገረው ይህ ነው። ይህ የሆነው ኢዮአቄም በይሁዳ ላይ በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት ነበር። ኢዮአቄም የኢዮስያስ ልጅ ነበረ። በዚያን ጊዜ ባሮክ ኤርምያስ የሚነግረውን መልእክት በጥቅልል መጽሐፍ ላይ ይጽፍ ነበር።

hi.L: वह वचन जो भविष्यद्वक्ता यिर्मयाह ने नेरिय्याह के पुत्र बारूक से कहा, जब वह यहूदा के राजा योशिय्याह के पुत्र यहोयाकीम के चौथे वर्ष में यिर्मयाह के मुँह से ये वचन एक पुस्तक में लिख रहा था:
hi.B: यह वह वचन है जो भविष्यद्वक्ता यिर्मयाह ने यहूदा के राजा योशिय्याह के पुत्र यहोयाकीम के राज्य के चौथे वर्ष में नेरिय्याह के पुत्र बारूक से कहा, जब बारूक यिर्मयाह के बोलने पर ये वचन एक पुस्तक में लिख रहा था:
hi.R: यह वह बात है जो नबी यिर्मयाह ने नेरिय्याह के पुत्र बारूक से कही। यह यहोयाकीम के यहूदा का राजा होने का चौथा वर्ष था। यहोयाकीम योशिय्याह का बेटा था। उस समय बारूक वे संदेश एक पुस्तक में लिख रहा था जो यिर्मयाह उसे बोलकर लिखवा रहा था।

ru.L: Слово, которое сказал Иеремия, пророк, Варуху, сыну Нирии, когда он записывал эти слова в свиток из уст Иеремии, в четвёртый год Иоакима, сына Иосии, царя Иудейского, говоря:
ru.B: Вот слово, которое пророк Иеремия сказал Варуху, сыну Нирии, в четвёртый год царствования Иоакима, сына Иосии, царя Иуды, когда Варух записывал эти слова в свиток под диктовку Иеремии:
ru.R: Вот что пророк Иеремия сказал Варуху, сыну Нирии. Это было в четвёртый год царствования Иоакима над Иудой. Иоаким был сыном Иосии. В то время Варух записывал в свиток слова, которые говорил ему Иеремия.

ja.L: ユダの王、ヨシヤの子ヨヤキムの第四年に、ネリヤの子バルクが、エレミヤの口から[聞いて]これらの言葉を巻物に書き記したとき、預言者エレミヤがバルクに語った言葉。それは次のように言う。
ja.B: ユダの王、ヨシヤの子ヨヤキムの治世の第四年に、ネリヤの子バルクが、エレミヤの口述に従ってこれらの言葉を巻物に書き記したとき、預言者エレミヤがバルクに語った言葉は、次のとおりである。
ja.R: これは、預言者エレミヤが、ネリヤの息子バルクに語ったことです。それは、ヨシヤの息子ヨヤキムがユダの王になって四年目のことでした。そのころ、バルクは、エレミヤが語るお告げを巻物に書き取っていました。

uk.L: Слово, яке пророк Єремія говорив Варухові, синові Нерії, коли той записував ці слова в сувій з уст Єремії, у четвертому році Йоакима, сина Йосії, царя Юдеї, кажучи:
uk.B: Ось слово, яке пророк Єремія сказав Варухові, синові Нерії, у четвертому році царювання Йоакима, сина Йосії, царя Юдеї, коли Варух записував ці слова в сувій під диктовку Єремії:
uk.R: Ось що пророк Єремія сказав Варухові, синові Нерії. Це було в четвертому році, коли Йоаким був царем Юдеї. Йоаким був сином Йосії. Тоді Варух записував у сувій послання, які промовляв йому Єремія.

decisions.choice: the setting of 36:1-4: the chapter steps back in time to the year the scroll was written
alternatives: a word given at a later time, after the events of chapters 43-44
decisions.reason: The fourth year of Jehoiakim was 605 BC (see 25:1). That is the year in which the LORD told Jeremiah to write all his words in a scroll, and Baruch wrote them as Jeremiah spoke them (36:1-4). So "these words" are the words of that scroll. Chapter 44 ends in Egypt, about twenty years later, after the fall of Jerusalem; this short chapter goes back to the earlier year. Placed here, it closes the account of Jeremiah's life with the promise to the man who wrote his words down and later went with him into Egypt (43:6).

decisions.choice: Baruch son of Neriah: Jeremiah's scribe
decisions.reason: Baruch was the scribe who kept the deed of Jeremiah's field (32:12-16), wrote and read the scroll (36:4-32), and was taken with Jeremiah into Egypt (43:3-6). His brother Seraiah son of Neriah was an officer of King Zedekiah (51:59). This is the only word in the book addressed to Baruch himself.

decisions.choice: from the mouth of Jeremiah: as Jeremiah dictated
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used for the writing of the scroll in 36:4, 27 and 32. Jeremiah spoke the words aloud and Baruch wrote them down (36:18).

decisions.choice: the word that Jeremiah spoke to Baruch: a heading in which the prophet passes on a message to one person
decisions.reason: Most headings in the book say that the word "came to Jeremiah" from the LORD. This one says that Jeremiah spoke it to Baruch, like the heading of the word he gave Baruch's brother Seraiah (51:59). The message is still the LORD's (verses 2 and 4).

decisions.choice: at Jeremiah's dictation (B); the messages Jeremiah spoke to him (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "from the mouth of Jeremiah". Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means (m3). Readable makes "these words" plain as the messages Jeremiah gave him, and splits the long heading into two sentences; it leaves out "saying", as Balanced does, because the message follows at once.

decisions.choice: in the fourth year of the reign of Jehoiakim (B); in Jehoiakim's fourth year as king (R)
decisions.reason: The date follows the wording set for dated headings in Jeremiah: "the Nth year of X's reign" at Balanced and "X's Nth year as king" at Readable. Readable gives Jehoiakim's father in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: en el año cuarto de Joacim (L); en el cuarto año del reinado de Joacim (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same year as 36:1, when the first scroll was written; the chapter goes back to that time.

decisions.choice: "두루마리 책" (L), "두루마리" (B, R); "예레미야의 입에서 받아 기록할 때" (L), "불러 주는 대로 받아 적을 때" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 36:2-4, since this chapter steps back to the year the scroll was written (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: da boca de Jeremias (L); enquanto Jeremias ditava (B); as mensagens que Jeremias lhe dizia (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase (m3) keeps the wording 36:4 gives it in Portuguese at each level, and the date the shape set for the book's headings (1:2; 36:1).

decisions.choice: Jehoiakim son of Josiah is "የኢዮስያስ ልጅ ኢዮአቄም" (the Kings forms); the scroll "ጥቅልል መጽሐፍ".
decisions.reason: The meaning decision ties the chapter to 36:1-4, where the same scroll is written and should be named alike.

decisions.choice: पुस्तक (scroll); यिर्मयाह के मुँह से (L), यिर्मयाह के बोलने पर (B), बोलकर लिखवा रहा था (R)
decisions.reason: The scroll (megillah) is पुस्तक, the ordinary Hindi Bible word for a written roll; "from the mouth of Jeremiah" means at his dictation, which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "Варух, сын Нирии"
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's scribe (m2), in the forms of 32:12 and 43:3 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "под диктовку Иеремии" (B); "слова, которые говорил ему Иеремия" (R)
decisions.reason: "From the mouth of Jeremiah" means as Jeremiah dictated (m3); Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: "в четвёртый год Иоакима" (L); "в четвёртый год царствования Иоакима" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The dated headings of Jeremiah keep the wording of 1:2-3 in this translation at each level.

decisions.choice: bashshanah harevi'it "第四年" (L), "治世の第四年" (B), "王になって四年目" (R), as the JER-1 year forms; Jehoiakim son of Josiah "ヨシヤの子ヨヤキム".
decisions.reason: m1: the setting of 36:1.

decisions.choice: The time clauses come before "…語った言葉" so the heading ends on its noun.
decisions.reason: m4: a heading; Japanese puts modifiers before the noun.

hi.L: "हे बारूक, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, तुमसे यों कहते हैं:
hi.B: "हे बारूक, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, तुमसे यह कहते हैं:
hi.R: "बारूक, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, तुमसे यह कहते हैं:

ru.R: «Варух, вот что говорит тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог Израиля:

ja.B: 「バルクよ、イスラエルの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、あなたにこう言われる。

uk.L: «Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог Ізраїлю, про тебе, Варуху:
uk.R: «Варуху, ось що каже тобі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог Ізраїлю:

decisions.choice: to you: the word is addressed to Baruch
decisions.reason: The small word used here can mean "to" or "concerning". Jeremiah often uses it where other books would use the word for "to". Both fit: the message is about Baruch and is spoken to him, and the name follows as a direct address.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (L); The LORD ... says this (B); this is what the LORD ... says (R)
decisions.reason: The formula as set for the prophets. The double quotation mark opens the word Jeremiah spoke to Baruch, which runs to the end of verse 5. Readable puts the name first, as a speaker addressing someone would, and says "Israel's God" for the title.

decisions.choice: ngươi (L); con (B, R), for Baruch
decisions.reason: The LORD's word to one man, given through Jeremiah, follows the terms note: "ngươi" at Literal, "con" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah speaks to Baruch, his scribe, in 해라체, as in 36:5-6
decisions.reason: The vocative "바룩아" goes first, as Korean addresses a person before speaking to him.

decisions.choice: a ti, Baruque (tu)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to Baruch with "tu" through the chapter, as he speaks to one person in the Old Testament and as 36:19 has him command Baruch.

decisions.choice: यों कहते हैं (L); यह कहते हैं (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula "Thus says the LORD" in the terms note's wording. The address to Baruch comes first, where Hindi puts a vocative.

decisions.choice: "Так говорит ГОСПОДЬ" (L, B); "Вот что говорит ГОСПОДЬ" (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula in the Prophets note's wording for each level.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah gives Baruch the LORD's word: "主はこう言われる"; God's words that follow are plain.
decisions.reason: JER conventions.

records.literal_gloss: You said, woe now to me, for has added Yahweh sorrow to my pain; I am weary with my groaning, and rest not I have found.

en.L: You said, 'Woe [is] me now, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and rest I have not found.'
en.B: You have said, 'Woe is me! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heaped sorrow on top of my pain. I am weary from my groaning, and I can find no rest.'
en.R: You said, 'How terrible this is for me! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has given me sorrow on top of my pain. I am tired out from groaning, and I cannot find any rest.'

es.L: Tú dijiste: “¡Ay de mí ahora, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha añadido tristeza a mi dolor! Estoy cansado de mi gemir, y descanso no he hallado”.
es.B: Tú has dicho: “¡Ay de mí! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha amontonado tristeza sobre mi dolor. Estoy agotado de tanto gemir, y no encuentro descanso”.
es.R: Tú dijiste: “¡Qué terrible es esto para mí! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha dado tristeza además de mi dolor. Estoy agotado de tanto quejarme, y no encuentro descanso”.

fr.L: Tu as dit : “Malheur à moi maintenant, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ajouté le chagrin à ma douleur ! Je suis épuisé par mes gémissements, et je ne trouve pas de repos.”
fr.B: Tu as dit : “Malheur à moi ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ajouté le chagrin à ma douleur. Je suis épuisé à force de gémir, et je ne trouve aucun repos.”
fr.R: Tu as dit : “Quel malheur pour moi ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné du chagrin en plus de ma douleur. Je suis épuisé à force de gémir, et je ne trouve aucun repos.”

sw.L: Ulisema, 'Ole wangu sasa, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameongeza huzuni juu ya maumivu yangu! Nimechoka kwa kuugua kwangu, wala sikupata raha.'
sw.B: Umesema, 'Ole wangu! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amerundika huzuni juu ya maumivu yangu. Nimechoka kwa kuugua kwangu, wala siwezi kupata raha.'
sw.R: Ulisema, 'Mambo ni mabaya sana kwangu! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenipa huzuni juu ya maumivu yangu. Nimechoka kabisa kwa kuugua, wala siwezi kupata raha yoyote.'

vi.L: Ngươi đã nói: 'Khốn cho tôi bây giờ, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thêm sầu khổ vào nỗi đau của tôi! Tôi mỏi mệt vì than thở, và tôi chẳng tìm được sự nghỉ ngơi.'
vi.B: Con đã nói: 'Khốn cho tôi! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chất thêm sầu khổ lên nỗi đau của tôi. Tôi kiệt sức vì than thở, và chẳng tìm đâu được sự nghỉ ngơi.'
vi.R: Con đã nói: 'Thật khốn khổ cho tôi! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã để tôi buồn khổ thêm trên nỗi đau tôi đang chịu. Tôi mệt lả vì rên than, và tôi chẳng được nghỉ ngơi chút nào.'

ko.L: 네가 말했다. '이제 내게 화가 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 고통에 슬픔을 더하셨다. 나는 내 탄식으로 지쳤고, 쉼을 얻지 못했다.'
ko.B: 너는 이렇게 말했다. '내게 화가 있다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 고통에 슬픔을 더 얹으셨다. 나는 탄식하다가 지쳐 버렸고, 쉴 곳을 찾지 못한다.'
ko.R: 너는 이렇게 말했다. '아, 나는 이제 끝났다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 고통 위에 슬픔까지 더하셨다. 나는 신음하다가 지쳐 버렸다. 쉴 수가 없다.'

pt.L: Tu disseste: 'Ai de mim agora, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} acrescentou tristeza à minha dor! Estou cansado do meu gemido, e descanso não encontrei.'
pt.B: Tu disseste: 'Ai de mim! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} amontoou tristeza sobre a minha dor. Estou esgotado de tanto gemer e não encontro descanso.'
pt.R: Tu disseste: 'Que desgraça para mim! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me deu tristeza em cima da minha dor. Estou exausto de tanto gemer e não consigo descansar.'

ru.L: Ты сказал: “Горе мне ныне, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} прибавил скорбь к моей боли! Я изнемог от моих стонов, и покоя я не нашёл.”
ru.B: Ты сказал: “Горе мне! {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} прибавил скорбь к моей боли. Я изнемог от стенаний и не нахожу покоя.”
ru.R: Ты сказал: “Беда мне! {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал мне скорбь вдобавок к моей боли. Я устал от стонов и никак не могу найти покоя.”

ja.L: あなたは言った。『ああ、わたしは災いだ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、わたしの痛みに悲しみを加えられた。わたしは嘆きに疲れ果て、安らぎを見いださない。』
ja.B: あなたは言った。『ああ、わたしは災いだ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしの痛みの上に、さらに悲しみを加えられた。わたしは嘆き疲れ、安らぎを得ることができない。』
ja.R: あなたは言った。『ああ、わたしはなんとひどい目にあうことか。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしの痛みに、さらに悲しみを加えられた。わたしは嘆き続けて疲れ果て、少しも休むことができない。』

uk.L: Ти сказав: “Горе ж мені, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} додав смутку до мого болю! Я змучився від свого стогону, і спочинку не знайшов”.
uk.B: Ти сказав: “Горе мені! {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} наклав смуток на мій біль. Я змучився від стогону й не можу знайти спочинку”.
uk.R: Ти сказав: “Як мені тяжко! {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав мені смуток на додачу до мого болю. Я змучився від стогону й ніяк не можу відпочити”.

decisions.choice: sorrow added to pain: grief of heart on top of suffering already borne
decisions.reason: The first word means sorrow or grief (8:18; 20:18), the second pain or suffering, of body or of mind (15:18; 30:15). Baruch says that the LORD has laid more grief on a man already in pain. The book does not say what the pain was. Writing down words of judgment against his own people, and the danger of carrying them to the king (36:16-19, 26), would be cause enough.

decisions.choice: I am weary with my groaning: the words of a lament
decisions.reason: The same two words open the cry of Psalm 6:7, "I am weary with my groaning". Baruch's complaint uses the language of prayers of lament, as Jeremiah's own do (15:10-18; 20:7-18). The LORD quotes it back to him before answering it.

decisions.choice: you said: the LORD repeats Baruch's own words
decisions.reason: The LORD answers by first stating what Baruch said, perhaps privately. The quotation is short and balanced, two halves divided by the main accent, like a line of poetry, but it stands inside a prose message, so it is kept as prose here, as the whole chapter is.

decisions.choice: Woe is me (L, B); How terrible this is for me (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for a cry of woe said of oneself, as in Isaiah and 4:31. Literal also keeps the small word "now", which strengthens the cry. Baruch's words take single quotation marks because they are quoted inside the word that Jeremiah speaks.

decisions.choice: heaped sorrow on top of (B); given me sorrow on top of (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to add more. Balanced and Readable say "on top of" to make the picture of one burden laid on another plain.

decisions.choice: ¡Ay de mí! (L, B); ¡Qué terrible es esto para mí! (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for *oy* said of oneself.

decisions.choice: "Ole wangu" (L, B); "Mambo ni mabaya sana kwangu" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for "woe" said of oneself in Swahili, as 1 Kings 13:30.

decisions.choice: "Malheur à moi" (L, B); "Quel malheur pour moi !" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording the French terms note sets for *oy* said of oneself.

decisions.choice: Khốn cho tôi (L, B); Thật khốn khổ cho tôi (R)
decisions.reason: The cry of woe said of oneself, as the terms note sets it (Isaiah 6:5).

decisions.choice: "내게 화가 있다" (L, B); "아, 나는 이제 끝났다" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for *hoy* said of oneself (6:5; Ps 120:5).

decisions.choice: Ai de mim (L, B), Que desgraça para mim (R); Estou cansado do meu gemido (L), esgotado de tanto gemer (B), exausto de tanto gemer (R)
decisions.reason: The cry of woe keeps the wording 15:10 sets for the book. Baruch's lament takes the words Psalm 6:7 has in Portuguese at each level, so the echo the English keeps (m2) is heard.

decisions.choice: "Woe is me" is "ወዮልኝ" (Literal, Balanced), the terms list's "ወዮ" with the first-person suffix; Readable "ይህ ለእኔ ምንኛ ክፉ ነው!".
decisions.reason: As the English levels; groaning is "መቃተት", the lament word.

decisions.choice: हाय (L, B); मेरा कितना बुरा हाल है (R)
decisions.reason: The woe-cry as the terms note sets it: हाय at Literal and Balanced, and at Readable the English level's plain lament put into Hindi.

decisions.choice: "Горе мне" (L, B); "Беда мне" (R)
decisions.reason: A cry of woe said of oneself, in the words of Isaiah 6:5 in this translation.

decisions.choice: 'oy na' li "ああ、わたしは災いだ" (L, B), "ああ、わたしはなんとひどい目にあうことか" (R) (ISA 6:5).
decisions.reason: Prophetic conventions; Baruch's lament is plain, with a respect form for the LORD ("加えられた").

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀תֹּאמַ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִ֨יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י הֹרֵ֔ס וְאֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־נָטַ֖עְתִּי אֲנִ֣י נֹתֵ֑שׁ וְאֶת־כָּל־הָאָ֖רֶץ הִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus you will say to him, thus says Yahweh: Here, what I have built I [am] tearing down, and what I have planted I [am] uprooting, and the whole land, it.

en.L: Thus you shall say to him: 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Look, what I have built I am tearing down, and what I have planted I am uprooting, and that [is] the whole land.
en.B: Say this to him: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: What I have built I am about to tear down, and what I have planted I am about to uproot, the whole land.
en.R: You are to tell him: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I am going to tear down what I have built and uproot what I have planted. I will do this to the whole land.

es.L: Así le dirás: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: He aquí, lo que edifiqué yo lo derribo, y lo que planté yo lo arranco, y [eso es] toda la tierra.
es.B: Dile esto: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Lo que yo edifiqué, lo voy a derribar, y lo que planté, lo voy a arrancar; toda esta tierra.
es.R: Tienes que decirle: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Voy a derribar lo que edifiqué y a arrancar lo que planté. Lo haré con toda la tierra.

fr.L: Ainsi tu lui diras : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Voici, ce que j’ai bâti, je le démolis, et ce que j’ai planté, je l’arrache, et cela, [c’est] tout le pays.
fr.B: Dis-lui ceci : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Ce que j’ai bâti, je vais le démolir, et ce que j’ai planté, je vais l’arracher : tout le pays.
fr.R: Tu lui diras : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je vais démolir ce que j’ai bâti et arracher ce que j’ai planté. Je le ferai à tout le pays.

sw.L: Hivi ndivyo utakavyomwambia: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, nilichokijenga ninakibomoa, na nilichokipanda ninaking'oa, nayo ni nchi yote.
sw.B: Mwambie hivi: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Nilichokijenga ninakaribia kukibomoa, na nilichokipanda ninakaribia kuking'oa, yaani nchi yote.
sw.R: Utamwambia: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitabomoa nilichokijenga na kung'oa nilichokipanda. Nitaifanyia hivyo nchi yote.

vi.L: Ngươi sẽ nói với nó như vầy: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Này, điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xây dựng, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang phá đổ, và điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trồng, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang nhổ đi, tức là cả xứ này.
vi.B: Hãy nói với nó như vầy: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xây dựng, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp phá đổ; điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trồng, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp nhổ đi, tức là cả xứ này.
vi.R: Con hãy nói với nó: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp phá đổ điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xây dựng và nhổ đi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trồng. Ta sẽ làm như vậy với cả xứ này.

ko.L: 너는 그에게 이와 같이 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보라, 내가 세운 것을 내가 허물고, 내가 심은 것을 내가 뽑는다. 이 온 땅이 그러하다.
ko.B: 너는 그에게 이렇게 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 세운 것을 내가 허물고, 내가 심은 것을 내가 뽑으려 한다. 이 온 땅을 그렇게 하겠다.
ko.R: 너는 그에게 이렇게 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 내가 세운 것을 허물고, 내가 심은 것을 뽑으려 한다. 나는 이 온 땅에 그렇게 하겠다.

pt.L: Assim lhe dirás: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Eis que o que construí eu estou derrubando, e o que plantei eu estou arrancando, e isso [é] toda a terra.
pt.B: Dize-lhe isto: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: O que construí estou para derrubar, e o que plantei estou para arrancar, a terra inteira.
pt.R: Tu deves dizer a ele: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Vou derrubar o que construí e arrancar o que plantei. Vou fazer isso com a terra inteira.

am.L: እንዲህ በለው፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ፣ የሠራሁትን አፈርሳለሁ፤ የተከልኩትንም እነቅላለሁ፤ [ይህም] ምድሪቱ ሁሉ ናት።
am.B: እንዲህ በለው፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ የሠራሁትን ላፈርስ፣ የተከልኩትንም ልነቅል ነው፤ ይህም በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ላይ ነው።
am.R: እንዲህ ትለዋለህ፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ የሠራሁትን አፈርሳለሁ፤ የተከልኩትንም እነቅላለሁ። ይህንንም በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ላይ አደርጋለሁ።

hi.L: तुम उससे यों कहना: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: देखो, जो मैंने बनाया है उसे मैं ढा रहा हूँ, और जो मैंने रोपा है उसे मैं उखाड़ रहा हूँ, और वह सारा देश [है]।
hi.B: उससे यह कहो: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: जो मैंने बनाया है उसे मैं ढाने पर हूँ, और जो मैंने रोपा है उसे उखाड़ने पर हूँ, सारे देश को।
hi.R: तुम उससे यह कहना: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: जो मैंने बनाया है, उसे मैं ढाने जा रहा हूँ, और जो मैंने रोपा है, उसे उखाड़ने जा रहा हूँ। मैं सारे देश के साथ यही करूँगा।

ru.L: Так скажи ему: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вот, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} построил, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} низвергаю, и что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} насадил, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} искореняю, — и это вся земля.
ru.B: Скажи ему так: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: То, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} построил, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сейчас низвергну, и то, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} насадил, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} искореню, — всю эту землю.
ru.R: Скажи ему: “Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} низвергну то, что построил, и вырву с корнем то, что посадил. Так {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поступлю со всей землёй.

ja.L: あなたは彼にこう言いなさい。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。見なさい、わたしが建てたものを、わたしは打ち倒し、わたしが植えたものを、わたしは引き抜く。それは全地である。
ja.B: あなたは彼にこう言いなさい。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは、自分が建てたものを打ち倒し、自分が植えたものを引き抜こうとしている。この地全体をそうする。
ja.R: バルクに、こう言いなさい。『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは、自分が建てたものを打ち倒し、自分が植えたものを引き抜く。この地全体に、そうする。

uk.L: Так скажи йому: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Ось що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} збудував, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} руйную, і що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} насадив, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} викорінюю, — і це вся земля.
uk.B: Скажи йому так: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} збудував, те {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ось-ось зруйную, і що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} насадив, те {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ось-ось викореню, — усю землю.
uk.R: Ти маєш сказати йому: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Я зруйную те, що збудував, і викореню те, що насадив. Я зроблю це з усією землею.

decisions.choice: you shall say to him: the LORD now speaks to Jeremiah about Baruch
decisions.reason: Verse 2 addresses Baruch; here the LORD turns to Jeremiah and tells him what to say to Baruch, and the message that follows (verses 4-5) speaks to Baruch again. The shift shows that the word came through the prophet.

decisions.choice: build and tear down, plant and uproot: the words of Jeremiah's call
decisions.reason: These are the verbs of 1:10, where Jeremiah is set over nations "to uproot and to tear down ... to build and to plant" (see also 18:7-9; 24:6; 31:28; 42:10). God himself built and planted his people in the land, and now he is undoing his own work. If God must tear down what he built, Baruch cannot expect to build great things for himself (verse 5).

decisions.choice: I am tearing down ... I am uprooting: judgment already under way or about to happen
decisions.reason: The word "look" with the participle points to something happening now or about to happen (35:17).

decisions.choice: the whole land: the land of Judah, the land God planted his people in
decisions.reason: The same word means "land" or "earth". The pictures of building and planting point to God's own land and people. The next verse widens the disaster to "all flesh", so a wider sense is possible, but the clause sums up what God built and planted. The words are added at the end, "and that is the whole land", to stress that nothing is left out.

decisions.choice: built ... tear down ... planted ... uproot
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the English verbs used in 1:10, so the reader can hear the echo of Jeremiah's call. Balanced and Readable say "about to" or "going to" for the near future (m3); Readable adds "I will do this to" to make the last words a sentence. The single quotation mark opens the message Jeremiah is to give, which closes at the end of verse 5.

decisions.choice: edificar ... derribar ... plantar ... arrancar
decisions.reason: The words of 1:10, kept the same where they return.

decisions.choice: "kujenga ... kubomoa ... kupanda ... kung'oa"
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call (1:10), kept as in 42:10.

decisions.choice: xây dựng ... phá đổ ... trồng ... nhổ đi
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call, kept as in 42:10. The LORD now speaks to Jeremiah about Baruch: "nó", the plain third person used for any man in God's speech.

decisions.choice: "세우다 / 허물다 / 심다 / 뽑다"
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call (1:10), the same wording as 42:10.

decisions.choice: construir, derrubar, plantar, arrancar
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call (m2) keep the Portuguese words 1:10 sets at every level.

decisions.choice: build / tear down / plant / uproot keep the verbs of 42:10 ("ሠራ … አፈረሰ፤ ተከለ … ነቀለ").
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the words of Jeremiah's call (1:10), here turned against the land; one wording for the four verbs through the book.

decisions.choice: बनाना, ढाना, रोपना, उखाड़ना
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah 1:10 and 42:10, in the same Hindi.

decisions.choice: "построил ... низвергаю, насадил ... искореняю" (L, B); "низвергну ... вырву с корнем ... посадил" (R)
decisions.reason: The verbs of 1:10 keep the Russian of that verse at each level, as in 42:10, so that the echo of Jeremiah's call is heard (m2).

decisions.choice: banah "建てる", haras "打ち倒す", nata' "植える", natash "引き抜く" (JER.1.10, 42.10).
decisions.reason: m2: the verbs of the call.

decisions.reason: m1: the LORD now speaks to Jeremiah.

records.literal_gloss: And you, you seek for yourself great [things]? Not seek! For here I [am] bringing disaster on all flesh, declaration of Yahweh, and I will give to you your life for plunder in all the places where you go there.

en.L: And you, do you seek great things for yourself? Do not seek [them]! For look, I am bringing disaster on all flesh, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but I will give you your life as plunder in all the places where you go.'"
en.B: As for you, are you seeking great things for yourself? Do not seek them. For I am about to bring disaster on all humankind, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but I will let you come away with your life as your plunder wherever you go.'"
en.R: Are you looking for great things for yourself? Stop looking for them! I am going to bring disaster on all people, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. But wherever you go, I will let you escape with your life as your prize.'"

es.L: ¿Y tú buscas para ti grandezas? ¡No [las] busques! Porque he aquí, yo traigo el mal sobre toda carne, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, pero a ti te daré tu vida por botín en todos los lugares adonde vayas”».
es.B: Y tú, ¿buscas grandezas para ti? No las busques. Porque voy a traer una calamidad sobre toda la humanidad, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, pero a ti te dejaré escapar con vida como tu botín dondequiera que vayas”».
es.R: ¿Estás buscando grandes cosas para ti? ¡Deja de buscarlas! Voy a traer una desgracia sobre toda la gente, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Pero dondequiera que vayas, te dejaré escapar con vida como tu premio”».

fr.L: Et toi, tu cherches pour toi de grandes choses ? Ne [les] cherche pas ! Car voici, je fais venir le malheur sur toute chair, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais je te donnerai ta vie pour butin dans tous les lieux où tu iras.” »
fr.B: Quant à toi, recherches-tu de grandes choses pour toi-même ? Ne les recherche pas. Car je vais faire venir le malheur sur tous les humains, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais je te laisserai emporter ta vie pour butin partout où tu iras.” »
fr.R: Cherches-tu de grandes choses pour toi-même ? Arrête de les chercher ! Je vais faire venir le malheur sur tous les gens, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Mais partout où tu iras, je te laisserai la vie sauve ; ce sera ta récompense.” »

sw.L: Nawe, je, unajitafutia mambo makubwa? Usiyatafute! Kwa maana tazama, ninaleta mabaya juu ya wenye mwili wote, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini nitakupa nafsi yako kama nyara katika mahali pote utakapokwenda.'"
sw.B: Na wewe, je, unajitafutia mambo makubwa? Usiyatafute. Kwa maana ninakaribia kuleta maafa juu ya wanadamu wote, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini nitakuacha uokoe maisha yako kama nyara yako popote utakapokwenda.'"
sw.R: Je, unajitafutia mambo makubwa? Acha kuyatafuta! Nitaleta maafa juu ya watu wote, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Lakini popote utakapokwenda, nitakuacha uokoke na maisha yako kama zawadi yako.'"

vi.L: Còn ngươi, ngươi tìm những điều lớn lao cho mình sao? Đừng tìm [chúng]! Vì này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giáng tai họa trên mọi xác thịt, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho ngươi mạng sống mình như chiến lợi phẩm ở mọi nơi ngươi đi đến.'"
vi.B: Còn con, con đang tìm những điều lớn lao cho mình sao? Đừng tìm kiếm những điều ấy. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp giáng tai họa trên cả loài người, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho con giữ được mạng sống mình như chiến lợi phẩm ở bất cứ nơi nào con đi đến.'"
vi.R: Con đang tìm những điều lớn lao cho mình sao? Đừng tìm những điều ấy nữa! Ta sẽ giáng tai họa trên mọi người, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Nhưng dù con đi đâu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ cho con thoát được mạng sống như phần thưởng của con.'"

ko.L: 그런데 너는 너 자신을 위하여 큰일들을 구하느냐? 구하지 마라! 보라, 내가 모든 육체에 재앙을 내리겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그러나 네가 가는 모든 곳에서 내가 너에게 네 목숨을 전리품으로 주겠다.'"
ko.B: 그런데 너는 너 자신을 위하여 큰일을 바라느냐? 바라지 마라. 내가 모든 사람에게 재앙을 내리려 한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그러나 네가 어디로 가든지 내가 너에게 네 목숨을 전리품처럼 건지게 해 주겠다.'"
ko.R: 너는 너 자신을 위하여 큰일을 바라느냐? 그런 것을 바라지 마라! 나는 모든 사람에게 재앙을 내리려 한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그러나 네가 어디로 가든지 내가 너의 목숨을 건지게 해 주겠다. 그것이 네가 얻을 상이다.'"

pt.L: E tu, buscas para ti grandes coisas? Não [as] busques! Pois eis que trago desgraça sobre toda carne, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, mas te darei a tua vida como despojo em todos os lugares para onde fores.'"
pt.B: Quanto a ti, estás buscando grandes coisas para ti mesmo? Não as busques. Pois estou para trazer desgraça sobre toda a humanidade, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, mas deixarei que saias com a vida como o teu despojo aonde quer que vás.'"
pt.R: Estás procurando grandes coisas para ti? Para de procurar! Vou trazer desgraça sobre todas as pessoas, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Mas, aonde quer que vás, vou deixar que escapes com vida, como se fosse o teu prêmio.'"

am.L: አንተስ ለራስህ ታላላቅ ነገሮችን ትፈልጋለህን? አትፈልጋቸው፤ እነሆ፣ በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ ክፉ ነገር አመጣለሁና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ በምትሄድበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ግን ነፍስህን እንደ ምርኮ እሰጥሃለሁ።”»
am.B: አንተስ ለራስህ ታላላቅ ነገሮችን ትፈልጋለህን? አትፈልጋቸው። በሰው ልጆች ሁሉ ላይ ጥፋት ላመጣ ነውና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ አንተን ግን በምትሄድበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ነፍስህን እንደ ምርኮ ይዘህ እንድታመልጥ አደርግሃለሁ።”»
am.R: ለራስህ ታላላቅ ነገሮችን ትፈልጋለህን? መፈለግህን ተው! በሰዎች ሁሉ ላይ ጥፋት አመጣለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። አንተን ግን በምትሄድበት ስፍራ ሁሉ በሕይወት እንድታመልጥ አደርግሃለሁ።”»

hi.L: और तुम, क्या तुम अपने लिए बड़ी-बड़ी [वस्तुएँ] खोजते हो? मत खोजो! क्योंकि देखो, मैं सब देहधारियों पर विपत्ति लाने पर हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, पर जहाँ जहाँ तुम जाओगे, वहाँ मैं तुम्हें तुम्हारा प्राण लूट के समान दूँगा।'"

hi.R: क्या तुम अपने लिए बड़ी-बड़ी चीज़ें चाहते हो? उनकी चाह छोड़ दो! मैं सब लोगों पर विपत्ति लानेवाला हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। पर तुम जहाँ भी जाओगे, मैं तुम्हारी जान बचाऊँगा। वही तुम्हारा इनाम होगी।'"

ru.L: А ты ищешь себе великого? Не ищи! Потому что вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навожу бедствие на всякую плоть, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — но тебе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам твою жизнь добычей во всех местах, куда ты пойдёшь.”»
ru.B: А ты ищешь для себя великого? Не ищи. Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу бедствие на всех людей, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — но тебе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам уйти, и твоя жизнь будет твоей добычей, куда бы ты ни пошёл.”»
ru.R: Ты ищешь для себя великих дел? Перестань их искать! Я наведу беду на всех людей, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. — Но куда бы ты ни пошёл, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам тебе уйти живым, и это будет твоей наградой.”»

uk.B: А ти шукаєш собі великого? Не шукай. Бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ось-ось наведу лихо на все людство, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, але тобі {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам винести за здобич власне життя, куди б ти не пішов”».
uk.R: Ти шукаєш собі чогось великого? Перестань шукати! Я наведу лихо на всіх людей, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Але куди б ти не пішов, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам тобі врятувати своє життя, і це буде твоя нагорода”».

decisions.choice: do you seek great things for yourself? A question that rebukes
alternatives: a statement: you are seeking great things for yourself
decisions.reason: Hebrew can ask a question without any word to mark it, and the strong "and you" sets Baruch against God, who is tearing down his own work (verse 4). The words can also be read as a statement of what Baruch is doing. Either way the command follows: do not seek them. The book does not say what the great things were, whether position, safety or success.

decisions.choice: all flesh: all humankind
decisions.reason: "Flesh" means human beings in their weakness and mortality (12:12; 25:31). The disaster is wider than Judah: the LORD is bringing judgment on the nations as well (25:15-31).

decisions.choice: your life as plunder: you will escape with your life, as a soldier carries off spoil
alternatives: life as the only thing saved; life as a prize won from the ruin
decisions.reason: The same saying is given to those who surrender to the Babylonians (21:9; 38:2) and to Ebed-melech (39:18); see the note at 21:9. Baruch will carry off one thing from the ruin, his own life, as if it were the spoil of war. The words can stress how little he will have, or the worth of what is saved.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew order, in which this word to Baruch follows chapter 44
alternatives: the Greek order, in which it comes near the end of the book, after the oracles against the nations
decisions.reason: In the Greek translation the oracles against the nations stand after 25:13 (see the note at 1:1), so the material of Hebrew chapters 44 and 45 comes after them, and this word to Baruch is placed at the end of Greek chapter 51, just before the final chapter. The Hebrew order is followed. This description of the Greek is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: let you come away with your life as your plunder (B); let you escape with your life as your prize (R)
alternatives: I will give you your life as a prize of war
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the wording of 21:9 and 39:18. Here the saying is a promise, so, as set for this saying, Balanced and Readable leave out the "only" that 21:9 has. Readable keeps the picture of something carried off from the ruin (m3) without deciding between its two senses.

decisions.choice: Stop looking for them!
decisions.reason: Readable turns the command into plain everyday words; it means the same as "do not seek them". The closing marks end the message Jeremiah was to give and the word he spoke to Baruch.

decisions.choice: escapar con vida como tu botín (B); escapar con vida como tu premio (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 21:9 and 39:18, here a promise to Baruch.

decisions.choice: "nafsi yako kama nyara" (L); "uokoe maisha yako kama nyara yako" (B); "uokoke na maisha yako kama zawadi yako" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 38:2 and 39:18 for "your life as plunder", here a promise.

decisions.choice: "ta vie pour butin" (L, B); "la vie sauve ; ce sera ta récompense" (R)
decisions.reason: The saying of 21:9 as a promise: without "seul", as 39:18.

decisions.choice: mọi xác thịt (L); cả loài người (B); mọi người (R)
decisions.reason: "All flesh" means all humankind; Literal keeps the Hebrew image, Balanced and Readable give the sense.

decisions.choice: "네 목숨을 전리품으로 주겠다" (L); "네 목숨을 전리품처럼 건지게 해 주겠다" (B); "목숨을 건지게 해 주겠다. 그것이 네가 얻을 상이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 21:9 (38:2; 39:18) at Literal; as a promise, Balanced and Readable drop "only" and say what it means.

decisions.choice: "모든 육체" (L); "모든 사람" (B, R) for "all flesh"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew word; the meaning decision gives "all humankind".

decisions.choice: a tua vida como despojo (L); sair com a vida como o teu despojo (B); escapar com vida, como se fosse o teu prêmio (R)
decisions.reason: The saying (m3) keeps the word "despojo" that 21:9 uses in Portuguese, as a promise here without the "only" of 21:9, as the English sets it.

decisions.choice: all flesh is "ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ" (Literal), "የሰው ልጆች ሁሉ" (Balanced), "ሰዎች ሁሉ" (Readable); "your life as plunder" keeps "እንደ ምርኮ" at Literal and Balanced, as 39:18.
decisions.reason: "ሥጋ ለባሽ" is the Amharic idiom for every human being; the promise to Baruch matches the one to Ebed-melech in 39:18 word for word in Hebrew.

decisions.choice: प्राण लूट के समान (L); प्राण लूट की तरह बचाकर ले जाना (B); जान ... इनाम (R)
decisions.reason: The same promise as to Ebed-melech in 39:18, in the same Hindi at Literal and Balanced; Readable follows the English "prize".

decisions.choice: सब देहधारी (L); सारी मनुष्य जाति (B); सब लोग (R)
decisions.reason: "All flesh" means all humankind; Literal keeps the picture of flesh in देहधारी (as 1 Peter 1:24 and 32:27), Balanced says सारी मनुष्य जाति, Readable people, as the English and the prophets note.

decisions.choice: "всякая плоть"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "all flesh"; it means all humankind (m2), which Balanced and Readable say with "все люди".

decisions.choice: "жизнь ... добычей" (L, B); "уйти живым ... наградой" (R)
decisions.reason: The saying of 21:9 and 39:18 in this translation (m3); here it is a promise, so Readable speaks of a reward, as the English says "prize".

decisions.choice: nafshekha leshalal "あなたの命を戦利品として" (L, B), "命だけは無事に持ち帰れる" (R).
decisions.reason: m3: you will escape with your life, as a soldier carries off spoil; R explains the image.
